reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no no-hire commitment and remains free to hire persons responding to general recruitment, which meets the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or comment is proposed, which is the correct handling for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text.

The failing deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are phrasing tests for narrowing an existing restrictive covenant and are inapplicable where no covenant binds Customer; adding such language would import a restriction adverse to us.
Rationale correctly declines to flag § 12.4 (Vendor-side competing-service restriction) as it runs in our favour.
